product_scope: OV Labs add-on; independent from BlenderOV/native Blender upstream approval

baseline_audit.authority_rule: This is a green baseline only, not the final release candidate.

intended_candidate.rule: Rerun exact package, lifecycle, security, validation, and approval gates after integration; do not promote baseline 007e results.

gates.finding: No checked-in GitHub workflow or config for CodeQL, vulnerability, secret, Bandit, Semgrep, Trivy, or equivalent scans was found at 007e.
Builder/materializer accept any absolute URL scheme; runtime manifest accepts non-empty but syntactically unsealed sha256/source_ref strings.
Traversal/link checks and focused Windows tests pass; 12 platform skips require Linux execution, and no explicit extraction size/count ceiling was identified.
Tokens come from environment/gh and subprocesses use argv rather than shell=True, but endpoint/redaction evidence is not sealed.
Hash provenance, runtime binding, re-download checks, and SBOM support exist; no release-artifact signing was found.

The MaterialX extension manifest and packaged LICENSE are Apache-2.0 while repository root is GPL-3.0; docs/licensing.md says release add-on archives include repository GPLv3. Treat this as an artifact-boundary documentation contradiction, not assumed incompatibility.
Focused baseline static/package gates are green but are not live runtime qualification or human approval.

experimental_override: Manual security override is allowed only for an experimental release and must record approver, reason, scope, exact commit/artifact hashes, accepted risks, expiry, and remediation owner; it is not a passed security card.
